description: Source code for a Requirements extractor script written in Rebol, which processes XML requirement files and extracts requirement IDs based on filters. It includes functions for file searching, XML parsing, and command-line argument handling, with user instructions and variable definitions.

methods.name: right
methods.description: Returns the last 'n' characters of a string.

methods.name: find-files
methods.description: Recursively searches a directory for files matching specified suffixes.

methods.name: req-xml
methods.description: Loads an XML requirement file and filters requirement IDs based on specified key-value filters.

methods.name: req-source
methods.description: Reads source files from specified directories, extracting lines marked with '@req' to gather requirements.
